observations.source: Dark cropped hair, round black glasses, blue short sleeved shirt, navy trousers and tiny shoes. Large block head, cuboid ears/hands, low polygon lobes, hard cloth joins; face and glasses legible but dark hair lacks broad turning highlights. Native meshes have armature deformation and baked actions.
observations.target: Warm smooth amber skin with rounded cheeks/head corners, plush multi-lobe navy-black hair with soft broad highlights; circular glasses and brown eyes; rolled short sleeves, purposeful collar, button placket, rounded shirt hem, visible trouser separation and rounded shoes. Friendly curved smile and cheeks.
observations.plantStyle: Saturated original palette, broad softly lit turning planes, warm small highlights and clear edges rather than washed out colors.
observations.implementationIntent: Preserve measured actual rig/root/action/contact contracts while rebuilding hard facial/clothing details and hair into soft volume. Use native editable geometry, consistent broad symmetric light and material response across views. Avoid target silhouette fitting or raster substitute.
